DISCOVERY POINT
Discovery Mast Climb

Prepare for the latest exhilarating experience aboard RRS Discovery! Embark on a thrilling ascent of the towering foremast of RRS Discovery, in a feat of courage with unbeatable views as your reward.

Santa's Grotto

Santa and his elves are coming back to Discovery Point this December for festive fun! Enjoy an enchanting family day out this Christmas in Santa’s Grotto, with singing, dancing, laughter and festive magic.

ABOUT US
Our mission for Discovery

Dundee Heritage Trust is a charity formed in 1985 to preserve the RRS Discovery for future generations. Now, we’re on a mission to spark curiosity in heritage, science, and discovery.

Learn more
ABOUT US
Conserving the RRS Discovery

Explore the £3.4M conservation project aboard the RRS Discovery, in a once-in-a-generation effort to preserve her for the next 100 years.

Learn more

COLLECTIONS
Polar Publications

Celebrate two iconic publications from our Polar Collection: the famous South Polar Times compiled on Discovery in 1902, and Shackleton’s rare Aurora Australis.

Read more
DISCOVERY POINT
The Hope Cross

Visit the historic Hope Cross at Discovery Point, built in 1922 by Shackleton’s Quest crewmates after his untimely passing.

Verdant Works Museum

Verdant Works Christmas Market: Food & Drinks

28 & 29 November 2026

11am-4pm each day

FREE entry to the Christmas Market!

—

We’re throwing our biggest festive market celebration yet at Verdant Works Museum; two weekends filled with Christmas magic in the heart of Dundee this November.

On weekend two, we’re bringing together a feast of Scotland’s best food and drink. Enjoy a weekend of festive food and drinks shopping and delicious treats at Verdant Works Museum; buy all you need to fill a fabulous Christmas hamper for your loved ones (or yourself!) as we proudly bring together the best food and drinks producers from Dundee, Fife, Perthshire and Angus in a celebration of Tayside.

After you’ve gathered all your special Christmas food, why not explore Dundee’s incredible industrial heritage, and weave your way to Victorian Dundee in this 1833 mill.

—

And, join us on 21 & 22 November 2026 for our Christmas Art, Craft & Design Market, with more than 25 of Tayside and Scotland’s talented designers, artists and independent makers.

Plan your visit RSVP on Facebook

Apply to be a stallholder
